acceptance: Recompute all saved binomial tails/calls exactly, including saved threshold.
Five candidates per row; feasible schedules have exact summed tail <=3/1000 and unchanged geometry/probability promises; fixed-cap resource rejections are retained.
Any promoted candidate must strictly beat saved calls; nonimproving selections are retained as negative diagnostics only. No comparison to superseded billion-call schedule.
No source/law/geometry/synthesis/physical or financial-delivery claim; no shared ledger change.
allocations: best prior plus three deterministic greedy slack rounds
frozen_inputs: Source family, continuous/support mode, moment, normalizer, interval geometry, chain T and certified stage probability bounds are unchanged. This screen assumes archived probability promises, and does not recertify their population financial bridge.
local_rule: Each round visits stages descending T then index; lower repetitions by one only if exact sum of max(small,large) tails stays <=3/1000. At most three rounds.
stopping_rule: Four declared allocations and one local candidate with at most three rounds, all four saved rows. No adaptive observed data or further sweep.
